title: Maan Singh v. State of U.P.
coram: Pankaj Mithal, J.; Umesh Chandra Tripathi, J.
disposition: Listed in the next cause list; Clause 6.5 remedy noted.
headnote: On a writ disputing the correctness of an electricity bill, the Court recorded that the petitioners have a remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. As none appeared for the petitioners, the petition was listed in the next cause list without a merits disposal or a direction to pursue Clause 6.5.
facts: Maan Singh and another petitioned the Allahabad High Court disputing the correctness of an electricity bill, impleading the State of U.P. and another. Counsel for the respondents appeared. None appeared for the petitioners. The Court noted a Clause 6.5 Supply Code remedy for the billing dispute and, on that non-appearance, directed that the writ be listed in the next cause list.

holding_units.holding: A consumer disputing the correctness of an electricity bill has a remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court recorded that remedy but, as none appeared for the petitioners, listed the writ in the next cause list without relegating the petitioners or deciding the bill.

not_decided.point: correctness of the electricity bill and whether the writ should be disposed by relegating the petitioners to Clause 6.5
not_decided.note: The Court noted the Clause 6.5 remedy but listed the petition for non-appearance.
